title: ViLBench: A Suite for Vision-Language Process Reward Modeling
authors_zh: Haoqin Tu、Weitao Feng、Hardy Chen、Hui Liu、Xianfeng Tang、Cihang Xie
paper_type_zh: 多模态过程奖励建模、MCTS 轨迹构造与测试时选择研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计多模态推理轨迹、终局裁判如何传导为步骤价值，以及 PRM 用于 Best-of-N 选择边界的读者
one_line: A multimodal PRM benchmark and a released 73,560-row MCTS-derived process/value dataset, where terminal GPT-4o judgments are propagated into continuous partial-solution scores.
ViLBench 同时提供面向过程奖励的多模态评测集与公开的 ViLReward-73K：后者把图像条件下 MCTS 的部分推理过程及其连续价值写成 73,560 行数据。
inclusion_reason: ViLBench is assigned to rollout, search, and test-time trace data because its released multimodal process-reward corpus turns image-conditioned MCTS partial solutions into scalar labels, and the paper uses the resulting PRM for Best-of-N test-time selection.

title: Problem
问题
html:
ViLBench joins two related but distinct artifacts. ViLBench is a 600-example evaluation set designed to distinguish output-level rewards from process rewards in vision-language reasoning. ViLReward-73K is the training-facing release: 73,560 image-conditioned partial solutions with continuous values. The paper trains a 3B scalar process reward model, ViLPRM, on the latter and uses it to select candidate answers at test time.

The release is relevant to the rollout/search/test-time trace-data track because the published rows are not ordinary question-answer pairs. Each row represents a partial natural-language process generated during visual MCTS and carries an inferred value. The public dataset has one default/train split and six columns: index, question, image_path, process, value, and source.

The card separates evidence from interpretation: the published row count, schema, source mixture, paper venue, and release links are directly checkable. The full MCTS tree, reference answer, terminal judge result, rejected branches, and exact construction run are not present in the released row schema and are treated as unavailable rather than reconstructed.

ViLBench 包含两个彼此相关但不能混为一谈的对象。ViLBench 是一个 600 题的评测集，旨在区分视觉语言推理中的结果奖励和过程奖励；ViLReward-73K 则是面向训练的公开数据：73,560 条带连续价值的图像条件部分推理过程。论文据此训练 3B 标量过程奖励模型 ViLPRM，并在测试时用它选择候选回答。

它归入 rollout、搜索与测试时轨迹数据赛道，是因为公开行并非普通问答对：每行是视觉 MCTS 中生成的一段自然语言部分过程，并附有推导出的价值。公开数据集仅有 default/train 一个 split，字段为 index、question、image_path、process、value 和 source。

本卡区分可核验事实与解释：行数、字段、来源混合、论文出处和发布链接可直接检查；完整 MCTS 树、参考答案、终局裁判结果、被拒分支及确切构造运行均未出现在公开行 schema 中，故保留为未知，而不自行补全。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The evaluation object draws 150 examples each from MMStar and MathVista, and 100 each from MathVerse, MMMU Pro, and RealWorldQA. It is selected from 5,848 source examples. The reported evaluation target is answer accuracy after reward-guided candidate selection, not a direct measure of annotation correctness.

ViLReward-73K begins with 16,926 prompts from three visual-math sources and two visual-perception sources. The paper reports 25,829 instances from MAVIS-Geometry, 31,406 from GeoQA170K, 1,425 from CLEVR-Math, 9,241 from A-OKVQA, and 5,659 from ScienceQA. The released Viewer confirms 73,560 rows, a single train split, English metadata, and image, tabular, and text modalities.

Each public record retains a question, relative image path, one process string, a floating-point value in the displayed range 0 to 1, and a coarse source label. It does not retain the upstream answer, an image binary inside the row, explicit step boundaries, tree IDs, visit counts, or a human explanation of why the value is correct. Image files are distributed separately according to the official repository instructions.

评测对象从 MMStar 与 MathVista 各取 150 题，从 MathVerse、MMMU Pro 和 RealWorldQA 各取 100 题，共 600 题，候选池为 5,848 个来源样本。论文报告的评测目标是奖励引导候选选择后的答案准确率，而不是对标注正确性的直接度量。

ViLReward-73K 从 16,926 个提示出发，覆盖三个视觉数学来源和两个视觉感知来源。论文报告的实例数分别为 MAVIS-Geometry 25,829、GeoQA170K 31,406、CLEVR-Math 1,425、A-OKVQA 9,241、ScienceQA 5,659。公开 Viewer 可核实总计 73,560 行、单一 train split、英文元数据，以及图像、表格和文本模态。

每条公开记录保留问题、相对图像路径、一个过程字符串、Viewer 显示范围为 0 到 1 的浮点价值和粗粒度来源标签；它不保留上游答案、行内图像二进制、显式步骤边界、树 ID、访问次数，或关于价值为何正确的人工说明。官方仓库说明图像文件需另行下载。

title: Method
方法
html:
For ViLBench construction, the authors evaluate six open-weight VLLMs as output and process reward models on 16 response candidates, then rank source examples by a PRM-preference indicator and sample the final per-benchmark quotas. This makes the benchmark intentionally sensitive to differences between process- and outcome-based selection; it is not an iid sample of the five source benchmarks.

For ViLReward-73K, selected prompts are searched with a visual-input adaptation of ReST-MCTS. The described search follows root selection, node expansion, route simulation, and value backpropagation. A prompt requests granular intermediate steps so that the model does not immediately emit the final answer. The paper reports ten MCTS iterations, but does not disclose the exact rollout policy checkpoint, decoding settings, seeds, or a per-prompt budget for the released corpus.

The authors describe three prompt-selection principles: distinct image content, questions intended to elicit reasoning, and source diversity. They choose the harder two MAVIS-Geometry levels as metadata candidates, one GeoQA170K question per unique image, multi-hop CLEVR-Math questions with distinct images, 1,544 non-direct plus 500 direct A-OKVQA questions, and ScienceQA examples above grade 7. The final source counts differ from some of these candidate descriptions after collection; the published Table 4 counts are the authoritative instance mixture cited here.

The feedback contract is mixed. GPT-4o judges a completed tree-search answer against the task answer; MCTS combines simulated continuation outcomes with a process-reward term to assign a partial solution a continuous value in [0,1]. The released record preserves only that final scalar, not the judge input/output or simulated children. It should therefore be read as a model- and search-conditional estimate of promising continuation, not proof that the visible local step is valid. The exact judge prompt, model version, answer-extraction rule, calibration, and adjudication agreement are unknown.

ViLPRM is a discriminative scalar model: Qwen2.5-VL-3B is fitted with a linear score head after the language head and trained by MSE against the derived continuous target. The paper does not use a generative score model for this component.

在 ViLBench 构造中，作者让六个开源权重 VLLM 以结果奖励和过程奖励两种方式评估 16 个回答候选，再按 PRM 偏好指标对来源样本排序，并按各基准配额取样。因此该评测集被有意筛成对过程/结果选择差异敏感的样本，而不是五个来源基准的独立同分布样本。

在 ViLReward-73K 构造中，选中的提示由支持视觉输入的 ReST-MCTS 变体搜索。文中描述的搜索依次包含根节点选择、节点扩展、路径模拟和价值回传；提示词要求更细的中间步骤，避免模型一开始就给出最终答案。论文报告十次 MCTS 迭代，但没有公开生成已发布语料所用的确切 rollout 策略 checkpoint、解码设置、随机种子或逐题预算。

作者给出三条提示筛选原则：图像内容互异、问题足以诱发推理、来源多样。候选来源包括 MAVIS-Geometry 最难两级、每张独特 GeoQA170K 图像的一题、需要多跳且图像不同的 CLEVR-Math 题、1,544 个不可直接回答加 500 个直接回答的 A-OKVQA 题，以及七年级以上的 ScienceQA 题。收集后的最终来源数与部分候选描述不同；本卡以论文 Table 4 的已发布实例数为准。

反馈契约是混合式的。GPT-4o 将完整树搜索答案与任务答案进行判断；MCTS 把模拟的后续结果与过程奖励项结合，为部分解答赋予 0 到 1 的连续价值。公开记录只保留最终标量，不保留裁判输入输出或模拟子节点。因此它应被理解为依赖特定模型和搜索的“后续有希望程度”估计，而不是证明可见局部步骤有效的证据。确切裁判提示词、模型版本、答案抽取规则、校准和裁决一致性均未知。

ViLPRM 是判别式标量模型：以 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 为基础，在语言头后添加线性评分头，并以 MSE 拟合派生的连续目标。论文未将生成式评分模型用于该组件。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Release evidence is strong for artifact existence but incomplete for label replay. ACL Anthology records the EMNLP 2025 paper and DOI. The official repository contains data-collection, PRM-training, response-generation, and Best-of-N scripts, and its README links the dataset. The public Hugging Face API and Dataset Viewer report one default/train split, 73,560 rows, six columns, and MIT license metadata.

Paper evidence supports the construction claim: Table 4 gives the 16,926-prompt to 73,560-instance expansion and per-source counts; the method states that GPT-4o judges final outputs and that visual ReST-MCTS propagates fine-grained values. The dataset schema independently supports only the persisted fields, not full node histories or terminal verdicts.

Performance is contextual evidence, not proof that every release label is reliable. On ViLBench, the paper reports a 1.4% average PRM-over-ORM advantage across its tested setting and reports ViLPRM average accuracy 31.5 versus 30.6 for URSA in Table 6. These are authors' benchmark results on a deliberately filtered evaluation set; they do not measure label error, judge agreement, source-data quality, or out-of-distribution behavior.

对发布物存在性的证据较强，但对逐标签回放的证据不完整。ACL Anthology 记录了 EMNLP 2025 论文及 DOI；官方仓库包含数据收集、PRM 训练、回答生成和 Best-of-N 脚本，README 链接该数据集。公开 Hugging Face API 与 Dataset Viewer 报告单一 default/train split、73,560 行、6 列和 MIT 许可证元数据。

论文证据支持构造主张：Table 4 给出从 16,926 个提示扩展到 73,560 个实例及其来源计数；方法部分说明 GPT-4o 对最终输出作判断，视觉 ReST-MCTS 回传细粒度价值。数据集 schema 可独立支持的仅是持久化字段，而不包括完整节点历史或终局裁决。

性能结果只是语境证据，不是每条发布标签可靠的证明。论文在其测试设置中报告 PRM 相比 ORM 平均高 1.4%，并在 Table 6 报告 ViLPRM 平均准确率 31.5、URSA 为 30.6。这些是作者在刻意筛选的评测集上的基准结果；它们不度量标签错误、裁判一致性、来源数据质量或分布外表现。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is not merely a larger multimodal answer dataset. It aligns three layers: a benchmark filtered to reveal when process rewards differ from output rewards, an image-conditioned MCTS construction procedure that turns terminal judgments into values for partial solutions, and a small discriminative PRM used in Best-of-N selection. This gives the release a trace-to-scalar feedback lineage that can be audited at the schema and method level.

The paper also makes a narrower empirical claim: reward-model behavior does not follow ordinary VLLM capability monotonically, and averaging only the last few step rewards can outperform both an output-only score and averaging all steps in its tested settings. That is a useful hypothesis about step aggregation, not a universal rule; the paper reports task sensitivity and no released calibration study for the labels.

Relative to a binary preference dataset, the public value field represents a continuous, search-derived target. The novelty has an audit boundary: full trees and terminal evidence are omitted, so the novel transformation cannot be replayed record by record from the public dataset alone.

其贡献不只是更大的多模态答案数据。它连接了三个层面：一个被筛选为能显出过程奖励与结果奖励差异的基准、一个把终局判断转成部分解答价值的图像条件 MCTS 构造过程，以及一个用于 Best-of-N 选择的小型判别式 PRM。这使发布物具有“轨迹到标量反馈”的谱系，可在 schema 和方法层面审计。

论文还提出较窄的经验主张：奖励模型行为并不随普通 VLLM 能力单调变化；在其测试设置中，只平均最后几个步骤的奖励，可能优于只用结果分数或平均所有步骤。这是关于步骤聚合的有用假设，而非普适规则；论文也报告任务敏感性，且没有公开标签校准研究。

相对于二元偏好数据，公开的 value 字段是连续、由搜索派生的目标。其新颖性存在审计边界：完整树和终局证据没有发布，因此不能仅凭公开数据逐条回放这一转换。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The public corpus is a flattened view of a search process. Without tree identity, parent/child edges, visit counts, terminal answer, or the GPT-4o verdict, a user cannot recompute the published scalar or distinguish a locally flawed step from one that happened to lead to successful continuations. This is a material constraint for reward-model training audits.

The label source is also indirect. A terminal proprietary-model judgment and sampled MCTS futures can encode judge bias, answer-equivalence mistakes, and policy-specific exploration effects. No human-label comparison, judge error rate, prompt release, or calibration analysis was found in the checked official paper, repository, or dataset card.

The paper itself reports that the benefits of PRM are not uniform: on MathVerse, text-dominant examples improve while visual-dominant examples decline under the reported setting. ViLBench is selected for PRM preference, so its scores should not be generalized to ordinary multimodal workloads. Upstream image/question rights, decontamination against training corpora, demographic coverage, and exact construction seeds remain undisclosed.

公开语料是搜索过程的扁平视图。没有树标识、父子边、访问次数、终局答案或 GPT-4o 裁决，使用者无法重算已发布标量，也无法区分“局部错误的步骤”和“恰好通向成功后续的步骤”。这对奖励模型训练审计是实质性限制。

标签来源也是间接的：专有模型的终局判断与采样的 MCTS 后续可能引入裁判偏差、答案等价判断错误以及依赖策略的探索效应。在所查官方论文、仓库和数据集卡中，没有发现人工标签对照、裁判错误率、提示词发布或校准分析。

论文自身报告 PRM 的收益并不一致：在所报告的 MathVerse 设置中，文本主导样本提升而视觉主导样本下降。ViLBench 又是按 PRM 偏好筛选的，因而其分数不应泛化为一般多模态工作负载的表现。上游图像/问题权利、与训练语料的去污染、人口覆盖度以及确切构造随机种子仍未披露。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned rollout/search/test-time trace-data track, ViLReward-73K is useful as a concrete example of converting multimodal search traces into scalar supervision and then using a learned scorer for Best-of-N selection. It can support schema inspection, source-mixture analysis, reward-model ablations, or studies of how a terminal judge is propagated to partial trajectories.

Use it with scope controls. A downstream trainer can consume question, image assets, process, and value as regression data, but should not represent the values as human step-verification labels. Evaluators can use ViLBench to compare ORM and PRM selection under the paper's targeted setting, but should add non-filtered, visual-dominant, and provenance-controlled tests before broader conclusions.

For reproducibility, preserve the dataset revision, record the separately downloaded image archive, and state that published rows do not reproduce the original search tree or GPT-4o judgments. A sensible audit baseline is to test sensitivity to source, value bins, process length, and visual versus text-dominant tasks, then manually examine cases where high values do not align with local reasoning validity.

对指定的 rollout、搜索与测试时轨迹数据赛道而言，ViLReward-73K 是“将多模态搜索轨迹转为标量监督、再以学习到的评分器做 Best-of-N 选择”的具体例子。它可用于 schema 检查、来源混合分析、奖励模型消融，或研究终局裁判如何被传导到部分轨迹。

使用时应设置边界。下游训练可把 question、图像资产、process 和 value 作为回归数据，但不应将这些价值表述成人类的步骤核验标签。评测者可在论文的目标设置下用 ViLBench 对比 ORM 与 PRM 选择，但在作出更广泛结论前，应补充未筛选、视觉主导和来源可控的测试。

为可复现性，应固定数据集 revision、记录另行下载的图像压缩包，并明确已发布行不能复现原始搜索树或 GPT-4o 判断。合理的审计基线包括：检查来源、价值分桶、过程长度与视觉/文本主导任务的敏感性，并人工复核高价值却与局部推理有效性不一致的案例。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep ViLBench evaluation examples separate from ViLReward-73K training rows; they have different construction goals and schemas.
  • Treat value as an MCTS- and GPT-4o-conditioned target, not a released proof that a visible step is correct.
  • The verified public dataset is one 73,560-row train split with six fields; the full search tree and terminal verdicts are unavailable.
  • Benchmark gains support a targeted selection claim only; they do not establish data quality, judge calibration, or general multimodal utility.

• 应把 ViLBench 评测题与 ViLReward-73K 训练行分开看待：二者的构造目标和 schema 不同。
  • value 是受 MCTS 与 GPT-4o 条件约束的目标值，而不是已发布的、证明可见步骤正确的证据。
  • 已核验的公开数据为单一 73,560 行 train split、6 个字段；完整搜索树与终局裁决不可得。
  • 基准提升仅支持特定选择设置下的主张，不能证明数据质量、裁判校准或一般多模态效用。

items: Continuous node values are derived from sampled future trajectories and a GPT-4o terminal judge; they are not direct human labels of the local validity of a reasoning step.
The released rows omit reference answers, terminal judgments, full trees, rejected branches, and judge prompts, preventing independent reconstruction of individual labels.
Image and question provenance inherits the source datasets' licensing, bias, and potential contamination concerns; decontamination is not disclosed.
The paper reports that PRM gains are task dependent and that visual-dominant MathVerse examples can lose accuracy, so a positive benchmark average does not establish general reward quality.
Exact generation checkpoint, seeds, decoding settings, judge agreement, and the per-prompt search budget are not disclosed in the checked official artifacts.
连续节点值由采样的未来轨迹与 GPT-4o 终态评审派生；它们不是对推理步骤局部有效性的直接人工标签。
已发布行省略参考答案、终态判定、完整树、被拒绝分支与评审提示，妨碍独立重构单个标签。
图像与问题出处继承源数据集的许可、偏差与潜在污染问题；去污染未披露。
论文报告 PRM 增益依任务而定，且视觉主导的 MathVerse 样例可能损失准确率，因此正的基准平均值并不确立一般奖励质量。
精确生成 checkpoint、种子、解码设置、评审一致性与逐提示搜索预算在所核官方产物中未披露。
